thread:
Ashwin: Heads up — we just saw a surge of late events causing stale aggregates for `user_session_hours` in eu-west. I want to propose a short 'shard cooldown' on active recomputes to prevent thrash and let priority lanes finish. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

OpsBot: Scheduled check: 12 new late shards detected. Suggested action: stagger replays.

Maria: Can you sketch what 'shard cooldown' means operationally? per-shard delay? window? Should interact with quota tokens.

Ashwin: Plan: when a shard fails >3 times in 1h, mark cooldown for 10m and move its recompute to low-priority queue. During cooldown we reduce concurrency for that shard from 8 -> 2 to avoid KV-store hotness.

Jordan: How will Console surface this? Need a per-shard state visible on the recompute dashboard + an overall throughput gauge. Also we should tag runs that were 'cooled' so we can filter in audits.

Tara: Ops handoff: if we set cooldown, SRE needs a runbook step: 1) verify stuck nodes, 2) bump replay tokens for customer-critical shards, 3) trigger manual resume. I'll draft a short playbook.

Kevin: Metric requests: expose `recompute.cooldown_count`, `recompute.shard_concurrency`, and `recompute.backfill_queue_depth`. Add alert if cooldown_rate > 0.1 over 15m. Also show cost estimate delta when we bump quotas.

Maria: One more: how do we handle KV cache invalidation? If a shard is cooled and then resumed, do we rehydrate caches? That's expensive.

Ashwin: For resumed shards we'll attempt a prefix-KV reuse policy: if last write < 5m then reuse, else full rehydrate. We can expose a checkbox in console: 'force rehydrate on resume'.

Jordan: UX: In the rollout view add a 'Backfill controls' panel — slider for priority % and a toggle for 'force rehydrate'. Also a progress ribbon across shards.

Tara: For tonight's run, can SRE take handoff at 22:00 UTC? If yes, we should create temporary quota bump: +15 tokens per minute for 2h. I'll add to oncall calendar.

Ashwin: Agreed. I'll open a temporary quota change request, tag @oncall, and attach the run id. Also will add a small code snippet for manual restart:

`````
# manual resume for shard
run_backfill --shard 42 --priority low --concurrency 2 --force-rehydrate=false
`````

OpsBot: Action created: ticket INF-4532 (temp-quota-bump) assigned to SRE. ETA: created.

Kevin: I'll add dashboard tiles and a quick chart to show cost delta per priority lane. Will push to staging and drop screenshots here.

Maria: Great. One more API debate — should the recompute API accept `cooldown=true` flag or should that be only a scheduler policy? I'm leaning scheduler-only to avoid client abuse.

Jordan: scheduler-only makes sense. We can keep the public API simple: `start_recompute(shard_id, priority)` and let server decide cooldown heuristics.

Ashwin: Ok consensus: scheduler-only. I'll log decisions in the RFC repo and link in the ticket. Next: assign owners for console changes and runbook.

Tara: I'll own the runbook. @Kevin please own dashboard tiles. @Jordan own console flow. Ashwin will lead scheduler changes. Maria will review RFC.

Maria: ack. :thumbsup: 

Ashwin: Thanks all. Follow-up: I'll post the RFC link and the test plan after 18:00 UTC. Closing thread for now.
